limitations.text: Inventory not completed. No labelled examples (get_examples returned 0), no imagery source permitted (imagery_window not_allowed for both GSI and Sentinel-2), zero_shot_text not configured, vision_subagent crashed. Only a synthetic 160 m AEF fixture index (3430 cells, 70x49, whole AOI ~9x8 km) was built; with no seed warehouse or visual check, embedding similarity cannot distinguish warehouses from factories/markets, and 160 m cells are coarse relative to a ~40 m building. A few-shot query at the AOI centre was arbitrary and is not a validated seed, so I report no warehouse points. Area reviewed: none to a verifiable standard; the whole AOI is unreviewed. Count: unknown (range not estimable; 0 verified). Chosen cell 160 m (finest available) vs Clay 1280 m (too coarse).

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses (>=~1600 m2) in AOI near Nagoya port area (136.82-136.92E, 35.05-35.12N), returning points with evidence, count range, and gaps.
known_limits: 10 m embeddings cannot resolve individual buildings well; Sentinel-2 10 m GSD; GSI aerial 0.5 m for vision checks limited to 20 cells per call; factories vs warehouses ambiguous.
understanding.scope: AOI ~9x8 km; year 2024; warehouses only, excluding factories, markets, hangars.
